main_text.p: tare, Obtemperare, Obedire: Niphal נִשְׁמַע Audiri: Obedire. Pihel שִׁמַּע Audiri fecit, Promulgavit. Hiphil הִשְׁמִיעַ Audire vel Audiri fecit, Promulgavit, Pronunciavit: Perfenuit.
שְׁמַע Chal. idem. Prat. שְׁמִעַת Audivi, Dan. 5.14 Partic. שָׁמְעִין Audiunt. Dan.3.7. Fut. כְּ הִשְׁמְעוּן Quum audietis, Dan 3.5. Hithpahel, Futur. וְיִשְׁתַּמְּעוּן Et auscultabunt, Dan.7.27.
שְׁמוּעָה m. f. Auditio, Rumor, Nuncium, Fama, Sonus: plur. שְׁמֻעוֹת. מִשְׁמַע m. שְׁמַע, שְׁמַע f. Auscultatio, Obedientia.
שְׁמֵךְ שְׁמֵן m. Particula, Pauxillum, Minimum.
שָׁמַר Custodire, Servare, Observare, Reservare. Niphal נִשְׁמַר Servari, Observari, Custodire se, Cavere sibi: Pihel שִׁמֵּר Observavit. Hithpahel הִשְׁתַּמֵּר Cavit sibi.
שְׁמִיר m. Sentis, Senticetum: item Adamas.
שְׁמָרִים m. p. Faeces, sic dicta quod vinum Conservent.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vowel points are approximate; the Hebrew forms are reconstructed from a faint scan and should be checked against the original. Running head and page number are partly illegible in the scan.
